content.title: Opendoor can be the Amazon of housing, investor Eric Jackson says
content.description:
Opendoor Technologies (OPEN) shares took off this week on news that the online real estate seller has tapped Shopify (SHOP) COO Kaz Nejatian to become the company's next chief executive.

EMJ Capital founder and president Eric Jackson — whose activist investment firm has a stake in Opendoor — weighs in on Opendoor's growth strategy moving forward.

Catch George Mason University finance professor Derek Horstmeyer explain why he views investing in Opendoor as "a little bit like buying a lottery ticket."

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

content.title: Opendoor Stock Soars 80% as Co-Founders Return. Why the ‘Open Army’ Is Snapping Up Shares.
content.summary: Opendoor Technologies has named  Shopify  Chief Operating Officer Kaz Nejatian as its new CEO and reappointed co-founders Keith Rabois and Eric Wu to the board.  Opendoor  shares soared 80% to $10.52 on Thursday, its largest single-day percentage increase on record and its highest close since Feb. 24, 2022, according to Dow Jones Market Data.  Shopify stock rose 2%.
